{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Every person has the right to acquire, own, use, possess, enjoy, and dispose of private property.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Supreme Court's Kelo decision allowed local governments to seize a person's home or land, not for vital public use, but for transfer to private developers.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The election of the next president may result in new appointments to the Court.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for state legislatures to pass legislation to moot the Kelo decision.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to pass federal legislation to protect against unjust federal takings.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to enforce the Takings Clause of the Fifth Amendment to ensure just compensation whenever private property is needed to achieve a compelling public use.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Urgence of caution in the designation of National Historic Areas, which can set the stage for widespread governmental control of citizens' lands.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The federal government has a special responsibility to the people in Indian country and a unique trust relationship with them, which has been insufficiently honored.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Social and economic problems in Indian country have grown worse over the last several decades.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to reverse the trend of worsening social and economic problems in Indian country.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Ineffective government programs deprive Indians of the services they need.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Long-term failures of government programs threaten to undermine tribal sovereignty.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
